title: AOK claim (evidence convention)
description: One graded claim under the AOK evidence convention (plan §2.1). Rules: (1) a [확인] claim needs at least one evidence item with a re-runnable or re-queryable `ref`; without one a verifier downgrades it to [추론]. (2) A conclusion takes the grade of its weakest premise. (3) Ratio claims (e.g. 'completion 80%') only from n>=10; before that report raw counts.

id.description: Claim identifier, unique within its document or claim ledger.

claim.description: The claim as a declarative sentence.

grade.description: Evidence grade: 확인 = observed/measured here (needs a re-runnable ref); 도출 = computed from graded inputs; 추론 = judgement; 미확인 = not verified; 기록됨 = recorded by another session; 문서 = verbatim tool/product documentation.

evidence.description: Evidence items backing the claim. Required (minItems 1) when grade is 확인.

scope.description: Where the claim holds: environment, versions and observation time.

grade.description: Condition: the claim is graded 확인.

evidence.description: At least one re-runnable evidence item.

allOf.description: A 확인 claim needs at least one evidence item (§2.1 rule 1).

grade.description: Evidence grade: 확인 = observed/measured here (needs a re-runnable ref); 도출 = computed from graded inputs; 추론 = judgement; 미확인 = not verified; 기록됨 = recorded by another session; 문서 = verbatim tool/product documentation.

evidence_item.description: One pointer to evidence that can be re-run or re-read.

kind.description: Evidence type: cmd = a command to re-run; event = a session transcript event; file = a file at a commit; url = a public URL.

ref.description: Re-runnable pointer: `session_id/event_uuid` for event, `path@sha` for file, the command line for cmd, the URL for url.

excerpt.description: Short verbatim excerpt of the evidence. Mask emails and personal names before storing.
